nanites.name: Repair Nanites
nanites.description: Dormant nanobots in your body. +10 max HP each run.

armorBoost.name: Makeshift Armor
armorBoost.description: A layer of ceramic plates welded under the skin. −10% damage taken in combat.

staminaBoost.name: Second Wind
staminaBoost.description: Accelerated cardio training between runs. +1 max stamina each run.

sharpBlade.name: Honed Blade
sharpBlade.description: You now know how to properly sharpen your weapons. +2 minimum damage with all weapons.

reflexes.name: Enhanced Reflexes
reflexes.description: Neural implant for reaction speed. +8% critical hit chance.

starterWeapon.name: Starting Arsenal
starterWeapon.description: A contact slips you a Tier 2 weapon at the start of the run. No questions asked.

startingFunds.name: Working Capital
startingFunds.description: An old forgotten bank account. +300 credits at the start of each run.

merchantContacts.name: Merchant Contacts
merchantContacts.description: Your network of dealers gives you a break. −8% on all market purchases.

starterCargo.name: Prepped Cargo
starterCargo.description: Someone loads your hold before departure. Start with 2 random goods.

spareTank.name: Spare Tank
spareTank.description: A jerrycan welded under the hull. +2 fuel at the start of each run.

engineTuning.name: Optimized Engine
engineTuning.description: Illegal modifications to the propulsion engine. +2 max fuel capacity.

travelScanner.name: Warning Scanner
travelScanner.description: Detects travel events before they hit. You see risks in advance.

reputation.name: Established Reputation
reputation.description: Your legend precedes your ship. +20 starting reputation.

nexusFragment.name: Fractal Memory
nexusFragment.description: A Nexus fragment follows you between runs. Start with one fragment already collected.

medkit.name: Care Inheritance
medkit.description: A family medical kit always ready in your cargo hold. +2 starting medicine.

lastStand.name: Last Breath
lastStand.description: Once per run, a blow that should kill you leaves you at 1 HP. You live to regret it.

coupDeGrace.name: Cold Execution
coupDeGrace.description: When an enemy is below 25% HP, your hits deal +40% damage. The kill is efficient.

factionTies.name: Old Ties
factionTies.description: Contacts from before keep you in mind. +30 reputation with your starting faction.

scoutTraining.name: Scout Training
scoutTraining.description: You arrive in each run with a zone already mapped. Start at depth 2.
